"""Additional exposure requires renewed breakout evidence, not an old fill anchor."""
import pandas as pd

from quantfusion.config.engine import default_engine_config
from quantfusion.domain.models import BarContext, Position
from quantfusion.strategy.trend import TurtleBreakoutStrategy


def _case(close=124., upper=132., stop=80.):
    cfg = default_engine_config()
    cfg.update(trail_atr_mult=10., reversal_turtle_enabled=False)
    strategy = TurtleBreakoutStrategy(cfg)
    dates = pd.bdate_range(end='2026-04-10', periods=45)
    frame = pd.DataFrame({'close': [130.] * 44 + [close],
                          'high': [131.] * 44 + [close + 1]}, index=dates)
    indicators = {name: pd.Series(value, index=dates) for name, value in {
        'atr': 8., 'adx': 40., 'donchian_upper': upper, 'donchian_lower': 90.,
        'ma_short': 115., 'ma_long': 100., 'reversal_low': 100.,
    }.items()}
    strategy.position = Position('300001', strategy.name, 1200, 100., '2026-01-05',
        stop_loss=stop, highest_since_entry=133., highest_close_since_entry=132.,
        units=1, last_buy_date='2026-01-05', last_add_price=100.)
    return strategy, BarContext(44, frame, 2e6, indicators, '300001', '2026-04-10')


def test_old_fill_gain_does_not_reuse_a_failed_breakout_for_more_exposure():
    strategy, ctx = _case()
    assert strategy.on_bar(ctx) is None
    assert strategy.position.shares == 1200
    assert strategy.position.units == 1


def test_fresh_prior_range_breakout_still_allows_a_causal_add():
    strategy, ctx = _case(close=134.)
    signal = strategy.on_bar(ctx)
    assert signal is not None and signal.direction == 'buy'
    assert signal.signal_date == ctx.date
    assert strategy.position.units == 1


def test_add_confirmation_cannot_delay_an_existing_stop():
    strategy, ctx = _case(stop=130.)
    signal = strategy.on_bar(ctx)
    assert signal is not None and signal.direction == 'sell'
    assert signal.target_shares == 1200
    assert strategy.position.stop_loss >= 130.
